# What SlickChart does

**Generated by `node scripts/build-feature-map.cjs`. Do not edit by hand** — `check-generated.cjs`
rebuilds it and fails CI if this file no longer matches the code.

Read this before answering "does SlickChart do X" or "is X saved anywhere". It exists because a
session once told the owner a provider's photos were gone when they had been on the server for
three weeks; the claim came from one comment about the EXPORT, generalised without grepping.
**Never state that a capability does not exist without searching this file first.**

## What leaves the device

Every call slickchart.html makes to the server, with the function that reaches it, following up
to 3 hops of helpers. **If something a provider creates is backed up, its upload is in this
table. If it is not in this table, it is device-only.**

It errs toward over-reporting: a listed call may be conditional, and a long helper chain can
attribute a call to a caller that only reaches it on one branch. That is the deliberate
direction — a spurious row costs a moment, a missing one cost a day. Use it to answer "is this
saved anywhere", not "does this always call that".

`announcements`, `auth_tokens`, `beta_events`, `build_purchases`, `client_events`, `client_login_codes`, `client_prefs`, `clients`, `consult_requests`, `course_versions`, `feedback`, `files`, `free_signups`, `google_connections`, `kv`, `kv_history`, `login_attempts`, `notify_log`, `nurture_optout`, `nurture_sends`, `provider_push_subscriptions`, `providers`, `push_subscriptions`, `reminder_log`, `sessions`, `square_connections`, `square_create_log`, `subscriptions`, `sync_requests`, `waitlist`.

Anything in these survives a lost or wiped device. Anything only in localStorage or IndexedDB
does not.

## Synced keys, and how each one merges on pull

A key that accumulates data and is NOT listed here rides the plain overwrite, which means a
stale device can wipe newer data from another one (CLAUDE.md §0.6).

**union by id + delete record (_mergeAuthoredById)**  
`sc_affiliate_links`, `sc_autos`, `sc_bundles`, `sc_checkins`, `sc_custom_note_templates`, `sc_docs`, `sc_inventory`, `sc_msg_templates`, `sc_needle_presets`, `sc_note_starters`, `sc_partners`, `sc_payments`, `sc_protocols`, `sc_reminders`, `sc_service_menu`, `sc_shop_bundles`, `sc_vc_types`, `sc_vendors`

**map of lists, union per bucket (_mergeAuthoredMap)**  
`sc_routines`

**grow-only object union (_TOMB_OBJ)**  
`sc_ci_dismissed`, `sc_course_purchases`, `sc_deleted_appts`, `sc_deleted_autos`, `sc_deleted_bundles`, `sc_deleted_clients`, `sc_deleted_docs`, `sc_deleted_inv`, `sc_deleted_needle_presets`, `sc_deleted_note_tmpls`, `sc_deleted_partners`, `sc_deleted_payments`, `sc_deleted_products`, `sc_deleted_protocols`, `sc_deleted_routines`, `sc_deleted_shop_bundles`, `sc_deleted_vc_types`, `sc_deleted_vendors`, `sc_deposit_handled`, `sc_hidden_courses`, `sc_hidden_forms`, `sc_hidden_guides`, `sc_hidden_square`, `sc_merged_ids`, `sc_merged_into`, `sc_summary_guide_optout`, `sc_undeleted_clients`

**grow-only list union (_TOMB_ARR)**  
`sc_ci_cleared`, `sc_ci_read`, `sc_deleted_sq`, `sc_flag_dismissed`, `sc_form_flag_dismissed`, `sc_home_dismissed`, `sc_imported_products`, `sc_notif_cleared`, `sc_notif_read`, `sc_photo_backed`

**sticky true (_STICKY_TRUE)**  
`sc_affiliate_custom`, `sc_courses_custom`, `sc_hide_sample`, `sc_orphan_dismissed`, `sc_photorelease_migrated`, `sc_protocols_custom`, `sc_service_menu_custom`

**per-client map (_mergeClientMap)**  
`sc_body_maps`, `sc_client_homecare`, `sc_client_recs`, `sc_healing_stage`, `sc_note_drafts`, `sc_photo_index`, `sc_pro_vc_invites`, `sc_rec_reasons`, `sc_session_summaries`, `sc_summary_guides`

**per-client map whose entries ACCUMULATE (_CLIENT_MAP_LIST)**  
`sc_photo_index`, `sc_session_summaries`

**Special-cased in `Cloud.pull()`**  
`sc_attn_seen`, `sc_availability`, `sc_bizinfo`, `sc_bookings`, `sc_brand_colors`, `sc_clients`, `sc_courses`, `sc_forms`, `sc_import_batches`, `sc_manual_appts`, `sc_msgstore`, `sc_pro_vc_subs`, `sc_resources`, `sc_seen_events`, `sc_sent_routines`, `sc_suggested_forms`, `sc_summary_drafts`, `sc_threads`, `sc_workspace`
